reading.body:
Vantage VA14 is one building in the Ashburn I campus, a six-building, 52-acre facility in Sterling, Virginia with 206 MW of critical IT load and 1.7 million square feet at full buildout across all structures. The operator publishes the campus total but not this specific building's capacity, so the individual facility's contribution to state and national capacity cannot be calculated from published data. At 300 watts per square foot, the campus density suggests this is a high-density AI-class facility, though the operator's published materials do not specify tenant workloads.

The Ashburn I campus ranks 24th in Virginia by published megawatt capacity among the 326 mapped facilities in the state, though only 23 facilities statewide publish power figures at all. Virginia's 23 published-capacity facilities total 1,375 megawatts, placing this campus at roughly 15 percent of the state's disclosed data center load. The rank reflects only published data; many larger unmapped or non-disclosing facilities may operate in Virginia.

No individual power purchase agreements, grid interconnection status, or build-out timelines for VA14 or the broader Ashburn I campus are published. Vantage's stated density of up to 300 W per square foot and six-building design indicate preparation for high-compute workloads, but without building-specific capacity figures or interconnection details, the extent to which this facility can actually draw power remains a published unknown.
